01 / THE SCHOOL

More than a lesson.
A local surf experience.

Snake Surf School was created from a surfer's connection to the ocean. Born in Safi and inspired by the home spot Head of Snake, Riyad brings years of surfing experience and a personal approach to every session.

03 / THE STORY

Born in Safi.
At home in the ocean.

I'm Riyad, a professional surfer and surf instructor from Safi. The name Snake comes from Head of Snake, my home spot — a wave and place that shaped my relationship with surfing.

Today I'm based in Imessouane, sharing that experience with surfers who want to learn, improve and enjoy the ocean safely.
